why: W15h (22 Oct 2026): the one home of the CI signing certificate SHA-256 (DER, lower-case hex). The build stops before patching when the keystore certificate differs (src/build/artifact_identity.py capture-signer), and docs/obtainium.json pins it as allowedSigningCertHashes, so Obtainium 1.6.16 or newer refuses an APK signed by any other key. Changing this value is a key rotation: every phone must re-import from the page (RECOVERY.md).
